name: B10-0423/2026 – Recital C – Am 5
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the upcoming EU anti-corruption strategy
part_text: C. whereas according to the 2025 Special Eurobarometer on corruption, 69 % of EU citizens believe that corruption is widespread in their country, while 73 % believe that corruption exists in national public institutions and 70 % in local or regional public institutions; whereas such findings demonstrate the persistence of a significant trust deficit between citizens and public authorities; whereas, over the years, the Special Eurobarometer surveys have also covered citizens’ perceptions of corruption within the EU institutions; whereas, following the Qatargate corruption scandal, the Commission ceased to publish such data, despite its long-standing and well-established practice of addressing this issue;
